intro: Our Sleepcot ET mattress brings everyday comfort to life. With plush, supportive, and breathable built, it wraps you in restful ease from edge to edge, night after night.

features.title: Extra-thick cushioning
features.text: Sink into layers of deep, plush comfort that cradle your body and help you drift into uninterrupted, cozy sleep.

features.title: Edge-to-edge support
features.text: Enjoy full mattress stability with consistent support across the surface—no sinking edges, just reliable comfort.

features.title: Breathable and cool fabric
features.text: Soft, airy fabric helps keep your sleep environment cool and fresh, even on warmer nights.

features.title: Durable and resilient foam
features.text: Crafted to last, the foam maintains its shape and bounce—delivering comfort you can count on for years.

features.title: Ideal for everyday comfort
features.text: Whether it's a full night's rest or a quick nap, this mattress offers comfort that's always just right.

features.title: Plush Euro-top Design
features.text: Topped with a luxurious Euro layer, it adds an extra touch of softness and elegance to your sleep space.

name: Sleepcot Et King Bed Foam Mattress 78 X 72 X 6 Inches
